title: Eyes Over Here!
description: Moves the >=26.1 Rabbit Remodel's Eyes to the sides.
body:
# Eyes Over Here!

![Every Rabbit with Eyes Over Here! applied](https://git.greenhouse.lgbt/Modding/eyes-over-here/media/branch/master/banner.png)

Eyes Over Here moves the 26.1 and later Rabbit texture's eyes to the side of the head.

This is a simple retexture inspired by my upcoming mod's former rabbit remodel, to make rabbits slightly more accurate to how their eyes are in real life.
